- Lyrics (full page and over the cover): at the first line, one more pull or flick down closes them (a shorter pull than before is enough).
- Lock screen lyrics: a new song takes the old song's line off at once (it stayed until the new song's first line).
- Lyrics of YouTube Music and Spotify songs are looked up by themselves: the artist is the song's own (the channel without Official / - Topic / VEVO) and the video words of the title ((Official Video), [HD], Lyrics) are left out; a song of the phone without "Artist - Title" in its name is looked up with its artist tag.
